item.title: How new Swedish migration rules could affect foreign residents in 2026

item.title: Sweden's death toll from storm rises to three

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Monday

item.title: What can you do with your kids in Sweden before term starts again?

item.title: What's open and closed in Sweden over the New Year holiday?

item.title: What will the weather be like in Sweden for the New Year's holiday?
